name: sol8-pending-change-reasons
goal: Retain explicit entity change reasons while results load without displaying a fallback absence claim.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Commit 920318ae54 hides all pending explanations, including supplied change reasons; the normal EntityOverview test catches the missing caller text.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The existing parent-consumer test already covers supplied reasons while pending; retain it and explicitly assert that fallback absence copy is also absent.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Admitted red 3ebda3a50182002e at 089508c4ee reproduces the missing supplied reason in the strengthened parent-consumer test.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Render explicit caller reasons during reading while withholding fallback absence copy; retain both assertions in normal parent-consumer coverage.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: The isolated repair 919a302689 retains explicit reasons during reading without changing any frozen test or fixture.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Matched green 4ada2cfec448c1dd passes the unchanged complete parent-consumer test corpus at 919a302689.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The isolated original source fails and repaired 919a302689 passes; pending74-guard-pair-fixed.json confirms identical frozen input hashes.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
